what: assets the drone benchmark needs that cannot be regenerated bit for bit; everything else is downloaded or rebuilt

drone_head.npz.what: the trained drone action head (1,348,672 weights, MLP 2052->512->512->64) + the normalisation statistics it was trained with (fmu/fsd/smu/ssd/ymu/ysd); numpy float32. Every published number used exactly this file.

gate_set.npz.what: the 256 gate frames (224x224x3 uint8 FPV renders), their prompts and drone states, their index in the training dataset, and the RTX 5090 eager reference actions on them (bf16 = the reference; fp32 = a control), [256, 16, 4] float32
